development_status: post-development extension; not preregistered or independently confirmatory

canonical_parent.xuetangx: C05/v0.3.1 preserved; do not retrain; excluded from demographic claims

research_questions: held-out predictability of directly excluded targeted fields
cross-dataset operational harmonization of sex_gender and socioeconomic_family blocks
survival of claims under paired family-wise uncertainty across budgets and stages

c14b.inputs: frozen C12 test predictions and C13 OOF predictions

tie_break.oulad: saved tie_key_sha256 after descending calibrated probability
tie_break.uci: exact C13 SecureEWS-C13A deterministic hash using dataset, row_id and original dataset seed

c14c.interpretation: predictability audit only; not proof that the EWS uses a proxy and not a fairness/privacy/causal test
c14c.predictor_view: exact targeted-exclusion retained outcome-model fields at each stage, excluding outcome, identifiers, split fields and future fields

evaluation.oulad_primary: fit fixed probes on 2013B/2013J; use 2014B only to select the balanced-accuracy decision threshold; test on 2014J without test-label use

c14e.family: dataset x subject/outcome x named policy/block x metric over all frozen stages x four budgets; probability metrics omit budget

reporting_guards: retain negative, null, unstable and contradictory results
never compare a restricted model to a full control from a different run
do not call operational harmonization measurement equivalence
do not call proxy predictability actual proxy use
do not claim formal non-inferiority, fairness certification, privacy guarantee or causal teacher effectiveness
keep OULAD, UCI697 and UCI320 separately identified
